summary: Cobalt's active scenery uses 13 geological prototypes and two main botanical families: ivory seed sails and red coral, each with three authored variants. This catalogue also includes a windborne seed and the distant coral representation.
caveats: Numbered rock, sail and coral IDs refer to positions in the source prototype or variant inventory, not the number of instances placed on the planet.
The three sail habits belong to one botanical family, and the three coral habits belong to another; these six variants are not six distinct species.
Distant coral is a simpler representation of the same coral population, not an additional species.
These entries cover the studio's scenery forms. Wildlife habitat plants and saved-find flora use separate geometry and materials and are outside this inventory.

items.name: Notched exposed bed
items.description: A low, broad cobalt bed divided by two open crooked joints, with peach sand resting on its upper planes.

items.name: Broken terraced reef
items.description: Three irregular stepped tiers form broad sloping ledges, with peach sand settled on two shelves.

items.name: Interrupted long ledge
items.description: Two separated low ledge segments sit beneath a smaller raised shelf and a narrow sand deposit.

items.name: Blunt jointed outcrop
items.description: A large block with clipped planar corners stands beside a smaller, lower block.

items.name: Detached split blocks
items.description: Two unequal clipped blocks form a broken pair, with the smaller fragment offset to one side.

items.name: Inclined fractured wall
items.description: Two inclined slabs have jagged sloping crests above a broad low foot and a peach sand seam.

items.name: Broken cliff buttress
items.description: Three unequal rising masses form a broken cliff, with a chipped tall crown and sand along the irregular foot.

items.name: Blunt fallen stone
items.description: A small flattened boulder with blunt clipped faces and a low profile.

items.name: Broad windward fin
items.description: A broad inclined stone sheet rises beside a lower profile, with a narrow sloping shelf carrying sand.

items.name: Wind-carved shoulder
items.description: A broad squat mass has a faceted shoulder and an uneven jagged crest.

items.name: Narrow leaning blade
items.description: A thin tall slab leans above a narrow footprint, ending in an uneven high crest.

items.name: Eroded low peninsula
items.description: A broad asymmetric low bed has a gently sloping top and an inset patch of peach sand.

items.name: Chipped mineral boulder
items.description: A chunky cobalt boulder has irregular clipped planes and a chipped sloping crown.

items.name: Paired kite
items.description: A curved branching tan stem carries two cupped ivory membranes with kite-shaped shoulders and fine midribs.

items.name: Tall fork
items.description: A tall curved stem carries three ivory blades: a slender crown, a branching side sail and a small lower leaf.

items.name: Broad wind flag
items.description: A lower leaning stem supports a broad asymmetric ivory membrane and a smaller side leaf, both cupped and twisted.

items.name: Spreading fan
items.description: A broad red fan has smooth joined branches, rounded blunt tips and open gaps between its forks.

items.name: Narrow upright crown
items.description: A taller, narrower red crown sends rounded branches upward through open rising forks.

items.name: Low windswept fan
items.description: A low wide red fan spreads through leaning branches with joined rounded forks and shallow physical depth.

items.name: Windborne seed
items.description: Two crossing slender ivory diamonds form a tiny airborne seed carried through the scenery.

items.name: Distant branching coral
items.description: Four simple angular branch tubes with blunt caps preserve the coral silhouette at a distance; this is a level-of-detail model of the existing coral.
